feature: D2 metric refinement: filter non-source files (test classes, docs) from fix ground truth in Jaccard localization scoring
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: _score_d2_localization filters fix_basenames to exclude test files (*Test.java, *Tests.java, *IT.java, *Spec.java) and documentation files (*.adoc, *.md, *.rst, *.txt). Agent localization (agent_files) is NOT filtered — agent should already emit source files only.

AC-2: A _is_test_or_doc helper or equivalent pattern is added to eval_harness.py with unit tests confirming it filters Test.java, Tests.java, .adoc, .md correctly and preserves plain .java source files.
AC-3: D2_buggy_only >= 0.30 on the latest n=20 run (was 0.254 before iter-2d, before adoc/test noise).
AC-7: pytest 320+ tests pass; ruff check clean.
edge_cases: EC-1: If fix_basenames after filtering is empty (e.g., fix only touched test files), return score=0.5 with details noting all fix files were test/doc — same as the 'fix unavailable from git' fallback, to avoid penalizing correct localization when the fix was test-only.
EC-2: Filter is applied to fix_basenames only — D3 and D5 still receive the unfiltered fix_files set (they need the full context for diff oracle and recommendation scoring).
EC-3: Filtering XML test configs (test-*.xml, *Test*.xml) is NOT included to avoid over-filtering — XML extension alone is insufficient to classify as test.
verification_method: 1. ruff check + pytest. 2. Unit test: _is_test_or_doc('FooTest.java')=True, _is_test_or_doc('Foo.java')=False, _is_test_or_doc('design.adoc')=True. 3. Re-run n=20 eval and confirm D2_overall >= 0.15, all 6 gates pass. 4. Confirm D3 score unchanged vs 2026-06-11_05-06-01_real_n20 baseline (0.350 ± 0.05).
